description: F7 rule 5 golden: the Almgren-Chriss eta path (iap.execution.optimal; API_TRADING.md sections 2.11 X-P2-15, 2.13 P0-5, 2.14 B3). calibration cases: ac_params_from_calibration with `coeff` already resolved (the slope or residual coefficient; the resolution from a calibration document is a dict read, not arithmetic) -> ACParams or {error}; trajectory cases: ac_kappa, ac_trajectory(qty, params, n, drift), ac_cost of those trades and of the optimal trades; drift cases: ac_drift_from_signal.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

slice.rule: per sample: price = 0.5 * (best_bid + best_ask) * tick; params = ac_params_from_calibration(sigma, price, adv_per_day=adv, horizon_s, risk_aversion, coeff); expected_return = (bid_sz - ask_sz) / (bid_sz + ask_sz) * 1e-4; drift = ac_drift_from_signal(0, expected_return, price, params.horizon); trades = ac_trajectory(10000, params, n, drift); plain = ac_trajectory(10000, params, n)

calibration.error: ambiguous units: pass either (adv, horizon) in one time unit or (adv_per_day, horizon_s), not a mix
adv_per_day and horizon_s must be given together
adv (or adv_per_day with horizon_s) is required
